zoe: Onboarding NyxLite7B (open ckpt) -> int4 quant. Quick smoke shows token duplication in long chat and occasional date hallucination. FP16 baseline clean.
kevin: converter used? tokenizer?
zoe: `convert-nyx.py` v0.2, tokenizer: SentencePiece v3 with NFKC in upstream. Converter output had no normalization flag. Runtime default rotary_scale=1.0.
anya: duplication + dates = classic rotary phase mismatch + token boundary changes. Check model.meta for per-head rotary scale.
zoe: upstream meta: `rotary_scale_headwise: [1.0, 0.97, 1.02, ...]` (per-head). Our converter collapsed to single `rotary_scale:1.0`.
triage-bot: tags `regression/quality`, `triage:needs-fix`
kevin: can you repro by forcing `--rotary-scale-headwise` array at runtime and toggling tokenizer normalization to NFKC? Also try disabling kvcache warmup.
zoe: tried runtime headwise override + NFKC + warmup off -> duplication gone on 19/20 failing chats; date hallucinations disappear. With only one of the fixes partial improvement.
ml-ci-bot: queued job #nyxlite-int4-headwise-canary
kevin: plan: 1) update converter to persist per-head rotary meta and tokenizer normalization; 2) add converter unit test: canonical text -> token ids match upstream; 3) add runtime fallback to read per-head rotary if present and apply automatically; 4) add `--kvcache-deterministic-warmup` flag.
anya: also add a small canary eval for chat long-context to catch regressions (ROUGE/EM + duplication heuristic).
zoe: opening PRs for converter + tests, and a runtime follow-up. attaching failing chat and canary job id. :white_check_mark:
